evidence: 63 unique matching week labels/start/end dates; finite climate features; population-weighted 168-hour rainfall source; source hashes recorded.
Paired raw-count direct-horizon ridge regressions, fixed alpha=1; common observation features and identical training pairs.
Exploratory statistical information screen, not a change to A2/A4 or a confirmed mechanistic climate model.
All 250 forecasts independently rerun and matched.
Ridge solution checked against augmented least squares; constant climate columns reproduce the no-climate model.
250 forecasts; per-fold scales/coefficients; 21 paired scope/horizon metrics independently recalculated.
Historical training origins s satisfy s+h<=n; per-fold scaling uses only eligible pairs.
Current-week climate availability is assumed and disclosed; no future actual weather used.

findings: Minimum training pairs is 13; correlated features and limited early data constrain interpretation.
Climate reduced paired-model MAE at horizons 2/4 but worsened horizon 1; climate model remains worse than A2 and Trend4 in aggregate MAE/RMSE.
No attribution to individual climate variables, causality, significance or independent validation.
Specific feature/penalty choices are exploratory and not final model approval.
